column1: # Geni relationship path: Emma Leonhart -> Bergitte Gunnbjørnsdatter Aukland
# LINE 2 of the three CLAUDE.md names, and the one that had never been captured.
# `reports/the-spine.md` said "The step-by-step path is not yet captured" because
# three attempts to expand the panel in a browser ended with the renderer timing out.
# Read straight out of the live DOM on 2026-08-26 rather than from a saved page:
# the relationship panel's `span.segment > span.name` nodes carry the name, and the
# sibling `a[href*="/people/"]` carries the Geni profile id. That is the same scoping
# `genimerge.genipage` applies to a saved file -- CLAUDE.md warns that matching
# `data-profile-id` anywhere on the page yields a plausible list that is not a path.
# The `?through=` form pins the relationship to Emma's own profile.
# Geni states "your 13th great grandmother", and 13 great-grandmother generations
# against 15 steps is consistent: two of the steps are the adoptive-mother link and
# The relation column is Geni's own wording and describes how THIS person relates
